# Situations

Every scheme answers each situation with what to use, what not to use, and why.

| Situation | Scope | What it means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Page title | typography | The title at the top of a page or view. |
| A number in a table | typography | A value people compare across rows. |
| Paragraph or help text | typography | Running text: help, descriptions, articles. |
| Field label or column header | typography | The name of an input or a table column. |
| A selected row or item | color | The item the user picked in a list or table. |
| An error message | color | Text that says something went wrong and how to fix it. |
| A link | color | Text that navigates. |
| A status | color | A short state such as paid, late or failed. |
| Items that belong together | spacing | A label and its value, or controls in one toolbar. |
| Between page sections | spacing | The break between two sections of a page. |
| Table row height | spacing | The vertical size of one row of data. |
| Corners of buttons and inputs | shape | The corner shape of interactive controls. |
| Shape of a status badge | shape | The outline of a status label. |
| A card on the page | elevation | A container that groups content inside a page. |
| A menu or dialog | elevation | Anything that floats above the page. |
| Hover and press feedback | motion | The response when a pointer or finger touches a control. |
| Someone asked for less motion | motion | The operating system setting for reduced motion is on. |
| An icon with no label | iconography | An action shown only as an icon. |
| Someone switches to dark | theming | The user or the system turns dark mode on. |
| Keyboard focus | accessibility | The control that keyboard input goes to. |
| The smallest clickable thing | accessibility | The minimum size of anything people can click or tap. |
| The action that completes the task | color | Save, submit, pay: the step that finishes the job. |
| An alternative or cancel | color | The other way out next to the main action. |
| Delete or remove | color | An action that destroys data. |
| An action on one row or item | iconography | An action repeated on every row of a list. |
| A value with no token | naming | You need a color, size or space that no token names. |
| A button label | voice | The words on a button. |
| The words of an error | voice | What an error message says, not how it looks. |
| A success message | voice | The confirmation after an action works. |
| An empty state | voice | What a list or page says when it has nothing yet. |
| A confirmation question | voice | The question before something hard to undo. |
| A first visit | voice | What the product says to someone new. |
